# API-FOOTBALL

> > Comprehensive sports data API platform providing real-time and historical data for football, basketball, hockey, and other sports with live odds, fixtures, statistics, and player information.

API-FOOTBALL is part of the API-SPORTS ecosystem, offering RESTful APIs with JSON responses accessible via HTTPS. The platform supports integrations with JavaScript, Google Sheets, and custom widgets, serving developers building sports data applications, betting platforms, and analytics tools.

## Key Topics

- API-FOOTBALL
- API-SPORTS
- Football data APIs
- Live odds and betting
- API-HOCKEY
- API-Basketball
- Real-time fixtures and statistics
- JavaScript integration
- JSON data format
- Widget customization

- Player statistics
- League coverage
- Google Sheets integration
- API quota management
